description: This file defines the class NonSeekableStreamDecodingEventStreamIterator, which extends DecodingEventStreamIterator to handle non-seekable stream decoding events in AWS API response parsing. It includes methods for parsing events, reading and hashing bytes, and implementing iterator functionalities.

classes.name: NonSeekableStreamDecodingEventStreamIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for decoding event streams from non-seekable streams, with methods to parse events, handle internal buffers, and implement iterator pattern functionality.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the iterator with a non-seekable stream, throws exception if the stream is seekable.

methods.name: parseEvent
methods.description: Parses a decoding event from the stream, verifying checksum and extracting headers and payload.

methods.name: readAndHashBytes
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes from the stream and updates the hash context.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Reinitializes the current event by parsing the next event.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances to the next event, reading additional bytes and parsing the event.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks if the stream has not reached EOF.
